registrationMethod: Native rounded integer projected pelvis/hip X is selected from anatomy and need not lie inside the support ROI. Ground Y is the exclusive alpha>=64 maximum Y of the explicitly named supporting sole, knee/hip or forearm/hand region; lifted soles, overhead arms and released weapons are excluded.
referenceHeightMethod: For each bearing independently, take the exact half-up median of all four contact cap-to-nearer-support-sole alpha>=64 native spans. Apply that one reference unchanged to both contact and casualty sources. SE [435,391,420,404] gives412; NW [404,381,373,383] gives382. No phase-specific, casualty-specific or borrowed normalization.

groundMethods: Projected pelvis X selected at belt/crotch axis; Y is alpha>=64 maximum exclusive Y in the nearer screen-left supporting boot outsole ROI.
Projected pelvis X follows the bent lunge trunk/pelvis; Y is alpha>=64 maximum exclusive Y in the rear screen-left braced support boot ROI, not the extended rifle.
Projected pelvis X selected at belt/crotch axis; Y is alpha>=64 maximum exclusive Y in the lower screen-left support boot ROI.
Projected pelvis X selected below the buckle/crotch; Y is alpha>=64 maximum exclusive Y in the lower screen-left support boot ROI; raised hands and weapon do not affect registration.
Projected pelvis X follows the belt/crotch axis in the stumble; ground Y is max exclusive alpha>=64 Y of the nearer planted screen-left boot, excluding the lifted rear boot.
Projected pelvis X follows the lowered hip; ground Y is max exclusive alpha>=64 Y of the planted screen-right front boot outsole, independent of lower knee and weapon.
Projected hip X follows the fallen pelvis; ground Y is max exclusive alpha>=64 Y of the folded weight-bearing knee/hip region. The raised rear boot and rifle bounds are excluded.
Projected hip X follows the side-rest pelvis; ground Y is max exclusive alpha>=64 Y of the resting wrist/hand at the end of the forearm. The separate lower rifle is excluded from the bounded ROI.
Projected pelvis X follows the rear belt/crotch axis; Y is alpha>=64 maximum exclusive Y in the nearer screen-left supporting boot ROI.
Projected pelvis X follows the bent-lunge pelvis independently of the rear boot; Y is alpha>=64 maximum exclusive Y in the screen-right rear forefoot/toe support ROI.
Projected pelvis X follows the rear belt/crotch axis; Y is alpha>=64 maximum exclusive Y in the lower screen-left support boot ROI.
Projected pelvis X follows the rear belt/crotch axis; Y is alpha>=64 maximum exclusive Y in the lower screen-left support boot ROI; overhead rifle and grips are excluded.

Projected pelvis X follows the rear belt/crotch axis of the stumble; Y is the alpha>=64 maximum exclusive Y of the planted screen-left boot outsole. The lifted rear boot and released rifle are excluded.
Projected pelvis X follows the rear hip beneath the belt; Y is the alpha>=64 maximum exclusive Y of the folded supporting knee region. Both upturned boot soles and the low rifle are excluded.

Projected pelvis X follows the side/rear hip under the belt and pouch; Y is the alpha>=64 maximum exclusive Y of the load-bearing folded knee/hip region. Raised boot soles, forearms and rifle do not set this ground.

Projected hip X follows the side-rest pelvis beneath the rear pouch; Y is the alpha>=64 maximum exclusive Y of the resting folded thigh/knee region. Upturned soles and the separate dropped rifle are excluded.
